source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 359 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 359 was established by Ordinance No. 21084, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 9, 1991. Ordinance No. 21084 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 359 is established on property generally located at the south corner of Midway Road and Accent Drive. The size of PD 359 is approximately 4.8702 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 359A). (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.105. USES.

The only use permitted on the Property are those uses allowed in the MF-2(A) district. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Unless otherwise specified, the Property must be developed in accordance with the MF-2(A) district regulations contained in Section 51A-4.116. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Dwelling Units
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.107. DWELLING UNITS.

Maximum number of dwelling units permitted on the Property is 240. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Height And Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.108. HEIGHT AND STORIES.

Maximum height for all structures on the Property is 40 feet. Maximum number of stories is three. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.109. SETBACKS.

Minimum setback for all structures except covered parking structures is 15 feet. Covered parking structures have no minimum setback. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

In this district, off-street parking is permitted in front of the required front building line. The number and location of off-street parking spaces must comply with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.111. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-359.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 359 is located on Zoning Map No. A-6. (Ord. Nos. 21084; 25850)
